About Us

About Alyséa Scents

Founded with a passion for luxury fragrances, Alyséa Scents was created to bring carefully selected perfumes to fragrance lovers across South Africa.

We believe fragrance is more than just something you wear. It's confidence. It's elegance. It's a memory that stays with you.

Every fragrance in our collection is selected with quality, beauty and customer satisfaction in mind — whether you're discovering your signature scent or choosing a gift for someone special.

Our Story

Our Story

Alyséa Scents began with a simple dream — to make beautiful fragrances more accessible while creating a luxurious shopping experience.

What started as a passion for perfumes has grown into a small business dedicated to helping customers discover scents they truly love.

Every order is prepared with care, appreciation, and attention to detail, because we believe every customer deserves to feel special. As Alyséa continues to grow, our mission stays the same: to deliver elegance, confidence, and unforgettable fragrances — one bottle at a time.

Est. 2026 · South Africa

Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I order?

Send us a WhatsApp message with the fragrance you'd like. We'll confirm availability, and payment is made via EFT. Once payment reflects, your order is prepared and dispatched.

Do you deliver?

Yes. We deliver nationwide across South Africa.

What payment methods do you accept?

EFT and Instant EFT.

Are your fragrances authentic?

We carefully source our fragrances from trusted suppliers to provide quality products.

What happens if a fragrance is out of stock?

We'll notify you immediately. You may choose an alternative fragrance or receive a refund.

Can you recommend a fragrance?

Absolutely — we'll gladly recommend fragrances based on your preferences.
